title: Playing through April 24! #goodmantheatre #seanhayes #chicagotheatre ...
transcript: yesterday was a beautiful spring day in chicago 70 degrees so what do i do? spend it in the theater yep i went to the goodman. LuPone alert!  to see “Good Night, Oscar” starring the one and only sean hayes now i really had no idea what to expect i knew of Jack Parr but musician and cunning wit Oscar Levant eluded me and now i wanna watch all the YT clips that exist of him Doug Wright’s play is a brisk 90 mins that has the handicap of many people likely not knowing who Oscar was so as a result the first 60min are really clunky exposition where we learn about who he is and why he matters but then the last 30min are just fantastic This play is a real time fantastical backstage drama set before and during the live taping of The Tonight Show with Jack Parr things get really messy backstage and then when the live show actually happens the show really really takes off i won't give too much away but this is the first time i've experienced a mid-show standing ovation during a play and Sean Hayes is just a star - go see it
reasoning: Despite the title mismatch (reviewer actually saw 'Good Night, Oscar'), the review is first-hand and recommends the show with a clear caveat about clunky first 60 minutes, then raves about the final 30 and Sean Hayes with a direct 'go see it'.
keyQuote: Sean Hayes is just a star - go see it
